name: Builder

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Insubstantial
traits.details: In ooze form, the Builder takes half damage from any damage source, except force damage and psychic damage. Whenever the Builder takes psychic damage, it loses this trait until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Ooze
traits.details: While squeezing in ooze form, the Builder moves at full speed rather than half speed, it doesn’t take the -5 penalty to attack rolls, and it doesn’t grant combat advantage for squeezing.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.details: While in warforged form, the Builder regains 5 hit points whenever it starts its turn and has at least 1 hit point. When the Builder takes force or psychic damage, the regeneration does not function on the creature’s next turn.

powers.name: Slam
powers.requirements: The Builder must be in warforged form.

powers.name: Psychic Touch
powers.requirements: The Builder must be in ooze form.

hit.description: damage, and the target’s equipment animates (save ends). While the target’s equipment is animated, the target is slowed and takes a -2 penalty to attack rolls.

powers.name: Possess Warforged
powers.requirements: The Builder must be in ooze form.

effect.description: Melee 1 (the intact body of one dead warforged); the Builder’s ooze form disappears into the target, and the Builder takes on warforged form.

powers.name: Leave Body
powers.requirements: The Builder must be in warforged form.

effect.description: The warforged body the Builder occupied falls prone in the Builder’s space, and the Builder takes on ooze form and shifts up to 2 squares.

powers.name: Fleeing Ooze
powers.trigger: While in warforged form, the Builder is first bloodied.

effect.description: The Builder uses leave body, gains 10 temporary hit points, and the warforged body it inhabited turns to dust.
